traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and requirements from docs/stories/022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE.story.md are fully implemented and verified:
- **Before/After/Mixed Positions**: Tests in tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts explicitly cover traceability annotations before other JSDoc tags, after them, and interleaved with them. All pass. - **Proper Termination & Tag Detection**: isNonTraceabilityJSDocTagLine treats any non-traceability `@tag` as a boundary. processCommentLine finalizes pending @story/@req when such a line is seen, preventing concatenation of subsequent JSDoc content into IDs (regression test with REQ-OPTIMIZATION confirms the original bug is fixed). - **Continuation Logic & Multiline Preservation**: Multi-line story values followed by JSDoc tags are accepted and correctly parsed, as shown by the "multi-line @story annotation before other JSDoc tags" test. Continuation only happens on non-tag, non-empty lines. - **Error Messages & No False Positives**: Existing invalid-format tests continue to verify detailed, actionable error messages, and the regression test ensures no spurious invalidReqFormat error when @param/@returns follow @req. - **Backward Compatibility**: The large pre-existing suite for valid-annotation-format and related helpers remains green, indicating no regressions in previous behavior. - **Documentation**: docs/rules/valid-annotation-format.md includes a JSDoc coexistence section with an example referencing this story.
Given the concrete implementation, targeted tests tied to this story, and a passing Jest run including all Story 022 scenarios, the story is fully implemented and stable.
